meta.name: Google Sheets Student Progress Backup
meta.description: Export and import student learning progress data to/from Google Sheets for cross-machine portability and data recovery
notes: OAuth credentials must be obtained from Google Cloud Console before first use
Only student learning progress data is backed up (users, quiz_attempts, concept_mastery, llm_quiz_attempts, attendance)
ChromaDB vector data is NOT backed up as it contains course content (not student data)
